manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed up while its velocity arrow, acceleration arrow and velocity-time graph move together. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: The left scene shows a ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows. The right graph shows v = u - g t with the current instant and its slope. Mass changes only the gravitational force.
